name: Rajasthani Hand-Painted Wooden Box (Purple Floral)
description: A charming purple box hand-painted in floral patterns, carrying the warmth of Indian artistry. Use it to hold your Agnihotra rice grains, ghee spoons, or small trinkets — functional and beautiful.
ritualSignificance: A beautiful storage solution that keeps your sacred items organized while adding artistic charm to your space.
